speaker: founder
text: Hi Maya, thanks for taking the time today. I'm Alex from Artisan. Quick housekeeping — I may take a few notes as we go, hope that's alright.

speaker: customer
text: Of course, no problem. Yeah, I'm Maya — VP Marketing here at MidCo. We're about 130 people, B2B SaaS, been around about four years.

speaker: founder
text: Great. So you clicked through our workflow automation case study last week — what was the context there? What's prompting the look at outbound right now?

speaker: customer
text: Yeah so — honestly our HubSpot setup has become a mess. We have sequences but our reps are spending like two hours a day doing manual follow-ups because the workflow automation just doesn't talk to our other tools. We use Intercom, we use Gong, and none of it is connected. It's a multi-tool integration problem more than anything.

speaker: founder
text: That's a classic problem when you're stitching together a stack. How long has this been the situation — is this new, or have you been living with it for a while?

speaker: customer
text: About a year. We actually tried Marketo before HubSpot and that was even worse — it took us nine months just to roll it out properly, and by the time we had it working, half the team had already built workarounds. That's part of why I'm gun-shy about buying new tools — implementation risk is real.

speaker: founder
text: That's completely fair — and honestly it's the number one thing we hear. The reason we can do two weeks is there's no implementation project, no SE engagement, no professional services. Ava connects to HubSpot in about forty minutes. If you're not live in two weeks, we refund the first month.

speaker: customer
text: Two weeks is — okay that's actually really different from what I expected. I assumed we'd be looking at a quarter-long onboarding. No dedicated SE involvement at all?

speaker: founder
text: None. Self-serve setup, we have a migration assistant that pulls your existing HubSpot sequences. And on the AI personalization side — Ava learns from your reply patterns over time, so the sequences get sharper as data comes in.

speaker: customer
text: Got it. The integration piece is what I keep coming back to honestly — like, does it actually push back to HubSpot automatically? Because right now reps are manually logging everything and it's a nightmare. If Ava can handle the multi-tool sync that's a big deal for us.

speaker: founder
text: Full bidirectional sync — HubSpot, Salesforce, Gong if you want it. All writes happen automatically. So on budget — have you scoped this at all, or is that still TBD?

speaker: customer
text: We have a rough range. Marketing ops budget for tools is somewhere around fifty thousand for the year. This would probably come out of that, so we're not unlimited but we're not starting from zero either.

speaker: founder
text: Good to know — that's definitely workable. Is there a timeline pressure, or is this more of a 'whenever we find the right thing' situation?

speaker: customer
text: We want something live before Q2 ends. We have a board update in July and I want to show pipeline numbers moving before then. So realistically we need to be onboarded and running by mid-June.

speaker: founder
text: Mid-June is very doable with a two-week deploy. One question on process — is this your call, or are there other stakeholders we'd need to get comfortable?

speaker: customer
text: I own the marketing budget so it's mostly my call, but I'd need to loop in Marcus from RevOps before we sign anything. He's actually pretty up on this space — I think he'd be positive. He's looked at similar tools before.

speaker: founder
text: That's helpful. Would it make sense to do a product demo with both of you — you and Marcus — so he can see the integration piece firsthand? We can get pretty technical on the RevOps side if that helps.

speaker: customer
text: Yeah, let's do that. I can pull Marcus in. Can you do sometime next week? I'm thinking Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon.

speaker: founder
text: Tuesday works. I'll send a calendar invite for both of you with a short agenda — we'll focus on the HubSpot sync and the workflow automation layer. Looking forward to it, Maya.

speaker: customer
text: Perfect. Thanks Alex, talk soon.
